It's hard to rank because it's clear you're a beginner - you have the hands of a beginner, which are unsteady and undisciplined. Though this means you should practice.

Your colour choices are very basic, as if you were using the three primary colours to paint with. You should break away from that habit in favour of adopting fresher, newer paints. Colors aren't made of RBG, they are made of CYMK - which is why many painters use these colors as a reference.

You have the basics of colour theory down, which is to make darker shades of the color you're working with instead of straight black or white. Though you have to manage your contrast (too much), it is clear you know about the technique.

You should put an effort into learning about color theory. You need to learn how to create contrast with color. You should also learn more about composition. Because I see potential here, but it looks uninformed.

This PDF really helped me learn about composition.
